ui.d398ae18ddb4: Idala iseshoni kwicala leseva; akukho mnxeba we-PSTN uthiwa wenzekile ngaphandle kokuba umboneleli wonxibelelwano athumele lo msitho kwi-webhook ekhuselekileyo.
ui.07ddb7f340fd: I-IVR: Cofa u-1 xa kukho impazamo, u-2 ukuze wenze idinga, u-3 ukuthetha nomncedisi.
ui.8ef964729e07: Ithatha umnxeba omdala kuye kolayini ize iwunikele kumncedisi olungileyo okhoyo (ukufaniswa kobuchule, emva koko ixesha elide lokulinda). Sisigqibo sokwabela kuphela — akuthethi ukuba kukho unxulumano lwenene lomnxeba.
ui.43db61570404: Imephu isebenzisa iLeaflet nedatha ephilayo ye-/v1/gis/fleet. Akukho manqaku ezithuthi enziwe yi-UI.
ui.17a1e3ec5d4a: Ikhamera nesikhangeli zibamba ubungqina ngokwasekhaya. Iikhoodineyithi zivela kwi-GPS, kwaye ubungqina bungathunyelwa kwiseva kusetyenziswa itikiti elivunyiweyo.
ui.06fa943be019: Uhlu luqinisekisiwe: ukungxama kwe-SLA + ukufaniswa kobuchule + umgama + umthwalo womsebenzi. Iseva ligunya lokwabela.
ui.f1a80e3e8395: Esi asisiso isikrini sokuhombisa nje. Uluhlu olungezantsi lwakhiwe ngokusekelwe kwisalathiso se-HTML esidityanisiweyo, kwaye luhlela umgangatho ngamnye ngokusekelwe kubungqina bokusetyenziswa okukwi-repository. Igama lempawu alithethi ukuba impawu igqityiwe.
ui.1e22c22f5622: Ufundo lwamabhuku emali luvela kwi-PostgreSQL kuphela. Akukho mphathi omkhulu we-AI ozimeleyo, akukho msebenzi wemali ozimeleyo, kwaye akukho ziphumo zokulingisa ezibonakaliswa njengenyaniso.
